purpose: Teach: ジャーナル/出社/引き受ける/役立っ/開場/引き締め/スワップ/手動

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界ジャーナル、最新号、目を、通しておくよう、社員にも、伝えろ、知識、武器だ。
lines.en: Get the latest industry journal in front of the staff. Knowledge is a weapon.
lines.style: Clipped, authoritative opening. Direct eye contact. Each phrase lands like a nail—no wasted air. 'Knowledge is a weapon' delivered with quiet force, not theatricality.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新入社員、初出社、来週月曜です、歓迎ムード、社内、整えております、温かく、迎えます。
lines.en: Yes. The new hire starts next Monday. We've prepared a warm welcome throughout the office.
lines.style: Respectful, attentive tone. Slightly formal register. Measured pace—each detail presented as evidence of readiness. Stands at attention in the voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 本件の責任、私が、引き受ける、心配せず、社員、安心して、業務に、専念しろ。
lines.en: I'm taking responsibility for this. Don't worry. Focus on your work with peace of mind.
lines.style: Steady, composed. Pause after 'responsibility'—the weight of it settles before the reassurance. Warm underneath the authority. A promise, not a performance.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。創業者のスピーチ、新人にも、本当に、役立った、と、感想、いただいております、嬉しいですね。
lines.en: Yes. The founder's speech was genuinely useful for the new staff—we've had really positive feedback. It's encouraging.
lines.style: Quiet pride in the detail. Bright moment breaking through formality. Lean forward slightly in tone. 'Encouraging' lands softly, like someone allowing himself to be pleased.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 新製品発表会、開場時間、お得意様、優先で、入っていただくように、整えろ、徹底だ。
lines.en: For the new product launch, make sure VIPs get priority when doors open. I want it executed flawlessly.
lines.style: Precise, almost clipped. 'Flawlessly' lands with finality—no negotiation. Professional distance, but the attention to detail shows he cares about the impression.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。経費の引き締め、社内、徹底中です、無駄な支出、見直しております、最近、特に。
lines.en: Yes. We're tightening expenses across the board—reviewing every unnecessary outlay, especially lately.
lines.style: Methodical, checking off items mentally. Slightly self-conscious precision—showing competence. Steady rhythm, no rush. Suggests work already in motion.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 通貨スワップ、海外取引、リスクヘッジに、活用しろ、為替変動、無視できないからな。
lines.en: Use currency swaps for overseas transactions. Hedge against foreign exchange risk—we can't ignore the volatility.
lines.style: Instructive, not condescending. Speaker knows this matters. Spare, technical phrasing. 'Volatility' delivered with weight—this is real exposure, not theory.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。緊急時、手動での対応、訓練、社員に、施しております、もしもの時、安心です、本当に。
lines.en: Yes. We're training staff on manual protocols for emergencies. When something happens, we'll be ready.
lines.style: Grounded confidence. 'Ready' lands without fanfare. Quiet reassurance—the kind that comes from preparation, not hope. Slightly exhaled, like a checkpoint marked complete.
